text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(There might be plenty of Umamusume
who are stronger than me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(There might be plenty of other Umamusume
who can run more captivatingly than me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(When it comes to this feeling alone, I refuse to lose
to any Umamusume! I will——)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I love running! I love it so much!!
I looooooove it so muuuuuch--!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
Trainer... I won...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...That was a good run, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I ended up losing though!
Still, I don't plan on backing down just yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I'm going to beat you.
Our rivalry is going to keep going, right?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Just what I wanted!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
First, though, let us praise her.
For running such a magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone else seems to be itching to go, too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
...I-nes! I-nes!
I-nes! I-nes!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
I-NES! I-NES!
I-NES! I-NES!
I-NES! I-NES!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! Ahaha!
Jeez, you're all getting way too hyped up...
Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your suppoooort!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did everyone have nice dreams?
I had so many today—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —I had such a wonderful dream!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It was really... so much fun.
The whole time I was running, I felt so happy...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so, so very much...!
